content: {"reasoning": "CPT 93229 requires prior authorization, which is MISSING, and this payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review. Submitting the claim would only draw an auth-related denial (CO-197) with no viable appeal path, and the patient cannot be billed for the provider's administrative failure to obtain required auth. Since no payer-facing action can properly progress collection and an available action resolves the balance, escalating to a scarce (and hasty) specialist is not warranted.", "action": "write_off"}
